## Packages

```{r packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(ggpubr)
library(Polychrome)
library(scales)
library(vegan)
library(flextable)
library(knitr)

source(here::here("R", "functions.R"))
dir.create("figures/ZIM", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
set.seed(5)
```

## Data

```{r data}
metadata <- read_delim("data/ZIM/zim2_baseline.txt", delim = "\t",
                       escape_double = FALSE, trim_ws = TRUE)
hmdb       <- read_hmdb(hmdb_path)
kegg_names <- kegg_compound_names("data/cache/kegg_compound_names.rds")

sampleids <- c(
  "ZIM089", "ZIM098", "ZIM106", "ZIM116", "ZIM125", "ZIM130", "ZIM139", "ZIM153", "ZIM160",
  "ZIM091", "ZIM100", "ZIM110", "ZIM117", "ZIM126", "ZIM132", "ZIM143", "ZIM155", "ZIM161",
  "ZIM094", "ZIM103", "ZIM111", "ZIM120", "ZIM127", "ZIM137", "ZIM146", "ZIM158", "ZIM162",
  "ZIM095", "ZIM105", "ZIM113", "ZIM123", "ZIM129", "ZIM138", "ZIM147", "ZIM159", "ZIM166"
)
setdiff(sampleids, metadata$PID)

zim_outputs <- c(output_dm     = "DietMicrobe_FFQ",
                 output_dm_ALL = "DietMicrobe_AllFoods")

subset_meta <- metadata %>%
  filter(Visit == 2, PID %in% sampleids) %>%
  mutate(diet = ifelse(WA_Difference > 0, "w", "a")) %>%
  select(PID, cohort = Cohort_Short, gender = Gender, diet) %>%
  na.omit()

results <- read_collapsed_results("data/ZIM/graph_results_ZIM.csv.gz") %>%
  filter(output %in% names(zim_outputs)) %>%
  mutate(PID = run_dir, experiment = unname(zim_outputs[output])) %>%
  select(-run_dir, -output) %>%
  inner_join(subset_meta, by = "PID") %>%
  mutate(
    pattern_type = case_when(
      compound1_origin == "food" & compound2_origin == "microbe" ~ "most",
      TRUE ~ "least"
    ),
    diet   = case_when(diet == "a" ~ "Agrarian",
                       diet == "w" ~ "Western"),
    cohort = case_when(cohort == "A" ~ "Naïve",
                       cohort == "B" ~ "Exp",
                       cohort == "C" ~ "HC"),
    cohort = factor(cohort, levels = c("Naïve", "Exp", "HC"))
  )
head(results)
```

## Core method validation

```{r tma search}
# choline (C00114) -> TMA (C00565)
results %>% filter(compound1_id == "C00114")

humann_output <- read_tsv("data/ZIM/Zim_KOs.tsv")
humann_output[startsWith(humann_output$Gene.Family, "K20038"), ]
```

```{r pheny search}
# phenylalanine (C00079/C02265) -> 3-phenylpropanoate (C05629)
results %>%
  filter(compound1_id %in% c("C00079", "C02265"),
         compound2_id == "C05629")
```

## Diet -> microbe reactions

```{r reaction breadth}
diet_microbe_hits <- results %>%
  filter(experiment == "DietMicrobe_FFQ",
         compound1_origin == "food", compound2_origin == "microbe")

reaction_level <- diet_microbe_hits %>%
  mutate(
    KO_list       = str_extract_all(KOs, "K[0-9]{5}"),
    n_KOs         = lengths(KO_list),
    organism_list = str_split(str_remove_all(organisms, "^\\['|'\\]$"), ",\\s*"),
    n_organisms   = lengths(organism_list)
  ) %>%
  distinct(reaction, compound1_id, compound2_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(reaction, compound1_id, compound2_id, KO_list, organism_list, n_KOs, n_organisms)

organism_reaction_map <- reaction_level %>%
  select(reaction, compound1_id, compound2_id, organism_list) %>%
  unnest(organism_list) %>%
  rename(organism = organism_list) %>%
  filter(organism != "unclassified")

organism_summary <- organism_reaction_map %>%
  group_by(organism) %>%
  summarise(n_distinct_reactions = n_distinct(reaction),
            n_distinct_pairs     = n_distinct(paste(compound1_id, compound2_id)),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_distinct_reactions))

KO_summary <- reaction_level %>%
  select(reaction, compound1_id, compound2_id, KO_list) %>%
  unnest(KO_list) %>%
  rename(KO = KO_list) %>%
  group_by(KO) %>%
  summarise(n_distinct_reactions = n_distinct(reaction),
            n_distinct_pairs     = n_distinct(paste(compound1_id, compound2_id)),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_distinct_reactions))

reaction_summary <- reaction_level %>%
  select(reaction, compound1_id, compound2_id, n_KOs, n_organisms) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_organisms))

organism_KO_summary <- organism_reaction_map %>%
  left_join(select(reaction_level, reaction, compound1_id, compound2_id, KO_list),
            by = c("reaction", "compound1_id", "compound2_id")) %>%
  unnest(KO_list) %>%
  rename(KO = KO_list) %>%
  group_by(organism) %>%
  summarise(n_distinct_KOs       = n_distinct(KO),
            n_distinct_reactions = n_distinct(reaction),
            n_distinct_pairs     = n_distinct(paste(compound1_id, compound2_id)),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_distinct_pairs))

org_summary_table <- head(organism_KO_summary, 20)
colnames(org_summary_table) <- c("Organism", "Distinct\nKOs", "Distinct\nReactions", "Distinct\nPairs")
save_as_image(width(flextable(org_summary_table) %>%
                      line_spacing(space = 1.25, part = "header"),
                    j = c("Distinct\nKOs", "Distinct\nReactions", "Distinct\nPairs"),
                    width = 1.0),
              path = "figures/ZIM/table_z_org_summary.png")
```

```{r top reactions}
food_lookup <- diet_microbe_hits %>%
  distinct(compound1_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(compound1_id, compound1_assoc_food)

reaction_level %>%
  left_join(food_lookup, by = "compound1_id") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_organisms)) %>%
  select(reaction, compound1_id, compound1_assoc_food, compound2_id, n_KOs, n_organisms) %>%
  head(15) %>%
  kable()
```

## Reaction composition by diet (FFQ)

```{r composition ffq}
rm_ffq   <- build_reaction_matrix(diet_microbe_hits)
comp_ffq <- reaction_composition_test(rm_ffq)

comp_ffq$permanova
comp_ffq$dispersion
comp_ffq$pct_var
comp_ffq$eig_check

plot_reaction_pcoa(comp_ffq)
```

```{r simper ffq}
simp_ffq <- simper_robustness(rm_ffq)
simp_ffq$simper
simp_ffq$permanova_reduced

sig_reactions_ffq <- simp_ffq$sig_reactions
```

```{r sig reactions}
reaction_labels <- c(
  R02199 = "R02199: L-isoleucine:2-oxoglutarate aminotransferase",
  R01090 = "R01090: L-leucine:2-oxoglutarate aminotransferase",
  R01579 = "R01579: D-glutamine amidohydrolase",
  R03163 = "R03163: L-fucose aldose-ketose-isomerase",
  R01432 = "R01432: D-xylose aldose-ketose-isomerase",
  R02437 = "R02437: L-rhamnose ketol-isomerase",
  R13064 = "R13064: naringin rhamnohydrolase"
)

sig_long <- rm_ffq$wide %>%
  select(PID, diet, all_of(sig_reactions_ffq)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(sig_reactions_ffq), names_to = "reaction", values_to = "abundance") %>%
  mutate(reaction_label = recode(reaction, !!!reaction_labels))

A <- ggplot(sig_long, aes(x = diet, y = abundance)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.3, size = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ reaction_label, scales = "free_y",
             labeller = labeller(reaction_label = label_wrap_gen(20))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Abundance") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r compounds foods, fig.width=15, fig.height=10}
patterns <- diet_microbe_hits %>%
  filter(reaction %in% sig_reactions_ffq) %>%
  distinct(PID, compound1_id, compound1_assoc_food, compound1_freq, diet, reaction) %>%
  group_by(PID) %>%
  mutate(pid_total_sig_freq = sum(compound1_freq[!duplicated(compound1_id)], na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(rel_freq = compound1_freq / pid_total_sig_freq,
         food     = map(compound1_assoc_food, parse_py_list_safe)) %>%
  unnest(food) %>%
  select(-compound1_assoc_food) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(reaction_label = recode(reaction, !!!reaction_labels))

kegg_lookup <- kegg_name_lookup(patterns$compound1_id, kegg_names, id_col = "compound1_id")

food_summary <- patterns %>%
  distinct(reaction_label, compound1_id, food) %>%
  count(reaction_label, compound1_id, name = "n_foods") %>%
  left_join(kegg_lookup, by = "compound1_id") %>%
  mutate(c_label = paste0(compound1_id, ": ", name)) %>%
  distinct()

exposure_df <- patterns %>%
  distinct(PID, diet, reaction_label, compound1_id, compound1_freq) %>%
  left_join(kegg_lookup, by = "compound1_id") %>%
  mutate(c_label = paste0(compound1_id, ": ", name))

# number of associated foods per compound
B <- ggplot(food_summary, aes(reorder(c_label, n_foods), n_foods)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Number of associated foods") +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = label_wrap(width = 10))

# compound intake frequency by diet
C <- ggplot(exposure_df, aes(x = diet, y = compound1_freq)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.3, size = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ c_label, scales = "free_y", labeller = labeller(c_label = label_wrap_gen(25))) +
  stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", label = "p.format",
                     label.x = 1.5, label.y.npc = "top", vjust = 1, hide.ns = TRUE) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Compound frequency")

stats_df <- exposure_df %>%
  group_by(reaction_label) %>%
  summarise(p_value = wilcox.test(compound1_freq ~ diet)$p.value, .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"))
stats_df

# top 10 foods per compound and diet
top_n_foods <- 10

stack_data <- patterns %>%
  distinct(PID, compound1_id, diet, food) %>%
  count(compound1_id, diet, food, name = "n_pid") %>%
  group_by(compound1_id, diet) %>%
  mutate(rank     = rank(-n_pid, ties.method = "first"),
         food_grp = if_else(rank <= top_n_foods, food, "Other")) %>%
  group_by(compound1_id, diet, food_grp) %>%
  summarise(n_pid = sum(n_pid), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(compound1_id, diet) %>%
  mutate(prop = n_pid / sum(n_pid)) %>%
  ungroup()

food_levels <- stack_data %>%
  filter(food_grp != "Other") %>%
  group_by(food_grp) %>%
  summarise(total_prop = sum(prop), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(total_prop)) %>%
  pull(food_grp)

code_lookup <- tibble(food_grp = c(food_levels, "Other")) %>%
  mutate(code = row_number())

stack_data <- stack_data %>%
  left_join(code_lookup, by = "food_grp") %>%
  mutate(food_grp = factor(food_grp, levels = code_lookup$food_grp)) %>%
  left_join(kegg_lookup, by = "compound1_id")

set.seed(42)
pal <- unname(createPalette(length(food_levels), c("#FF0000", "#00FF00", "#0000FF")))
food_colors <- setNames(c(pal, "grey70"), code_lookup$food_grp)
class_labels_numbered <- setNames(paste0(code_lookup$code, ": ", code_lookup$food_grp),
                                  code_lookup$food_grp)

top_foods <- ggplot(stack_data, aes(x = diet, y = prop, fill = food_grp)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill") +
  geom_text(aes(label = code), position = position_fill(vjust = 0.5),
            size = 3, color = "grey4", fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = food_colors, labels = label_wrap(20)(class_labels_numbered)) +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~ name, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(5.5, 5.5, 5.5, 5.5)) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Proportion", fill = "Food",
       title = "Proportion of compound intake by contributing food")

top_panel <- plot_grid(A, C, B, ncol = 3, nrow = 1,
                       labels = c("A", "B", "C"), rel_widths = c(1, 1, 0.5))
figure_reaction <- plot_grid(top_panel, top_foods, nrow = 2, ncol = 1,
                             rel_heights = c(0.7, 1), labels = c("", "D"))
figure_reaction

save_plot(filename = "figures/ZIM/figure_z_reaction_info.png", figure_reaction,
          base_height = 10, base_width = 17)
```

```{r reaction organisms}
genus_counts <- diet_microbe_hits %>%
  filter(reaction %in% sig_reactions_ffq) %>%
  select(diet, reaction, organisms) %>%
  mutate(orgs = parse_py_list_orgs(organisms)) %>%
  unnest(orgs) %>%
  select(-organisms) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(diet) %>%
  mutate(genus = str_extract(orgs, "(?<=g__)[^.]+")) %>%
  count(reaction, genus, name = "n") %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  mutate(reaction_label = recode(reaction, !!!reaction_labels)) %>%
  ungroup()

rn_organism <- ggplot(genus_counts, aes(x = reaction_label, y = genus, fill = n)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "grey", high = "darkred", name = "Number of\nSpecies") +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 20)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Reaction", y = "Genus", fill = "Count") +
  facet_grid(~ diet)

save_plot(filename = "figures/ZIM/figure_z_rn_organism.png", rn_organism,
          base_height = 10, base_width = 12)
```

```{r reaction compounds table}
all_ids <- results %>%
  filter(reaction %in% sig_reactions_ffq) %>%
  select(compound1_id, compound2_id) %>%
  unlist() %>%
  unique() %>%
  na.omit()

id_lookup  <- kegg_name_lookup(all_ids, kegg_names)
id_to_name <- setNames(id_lookup$name, id_lookup$kegg_id)

sig_reactions_table <- diet_microbe_hits %>%
  filter(reaction %in% sig_reactions_ffq) %>%
  select(compound1_id, reaction, compound2_id) %>%
  mutate(
    reaction       = recode(reaction, !!!reaction_labels),
    compound1_name = recode(compound1_id, !!!id_to_name, .default = compound1_id),
    compound2_name = recode(compound2_id, !!!id_to_name, .default = compound2_id)
  ) %>%
  select(`Food Compound ID`      = compound1_id,
         `Food Compound`         = compound1_name,
         Reaction                = reaction,
         `Microbe Metabolite ID` = compound2_id,
         `Microbe Metabolite`    = compound2_name) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  arrange(Reaction)

save_as_image(flextable(sig_reactions_table), path = "figures/ZIM/table_z_sig_reactions.png")
```

pattern_summary <- results %>%
  count(experiment, pattern_type, PID, name = "n") %>%
  group_by(experiment, pattern_type) %>%

```{r node summary}
# one row per compound occurrence, with HMDB taxonomy (kept when unclassified)
df_base <- results %>%
  select(experiment, matches("^compound[12]_(id|origin|assoc_food|freq)$")) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = matches("^compound[12]_"),
               names_to = c("compound_num", ".value"),
               names_pattern = "compound(\\d)_(.*)") %>%
  filter(!is.na(id), id != "") %>%
  mutate(origin = case_when(origin == "both" ~ "microbediet",
                            origin == "food" ~ "diet",
                            TRUE             ~ origin)) %>%
  rename(kegg_id = id) %>%
  left_join(hmdb, by = "kegg_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(origin)) %>%
  distinct(kegg_id, origin, taxonomy_class, experiment, compound_num)

df_base %>%
  distinct(kegg_id, taxonomy_class) %>%
  count(taxonomy_class, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(perc = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
  arrange(desc(perc))

class_counts <- df_base %>%
  filter(!is.na(taxonomy_class)) %>%
  count(origin, taxonomy_class, experiment, compound_num)

class_levels <- sort(unique(class_counts$taxonomy_class))
class_labels <- setNames(paste0(seq_along(class_levels), ". ", class_levels), class_levels)
class_labels_wrapped <- setNames(str_wrap(class_labels, width = 25), names(class_labels))

pal <- as.vector(createPalette(length(class_levels), c("#010101", "#ff0000")))
names(pal) <- class_levels

class_counts <- class_counts %>%
  mutate(taxonomy_class = factor(taxonomy_class, levels = class_levels),
         x_label = interaction(compound_num, origin, sep = " · "),
         x_label = fct_reorder(x_label, as.integer(compound_num), .desc = TRUE))

# classified vs. unclassified compound counts per bar
totals_df <- df_base %>%
  mutate(status = ifelse(is.na(taxonomy_class), "Unclassified", "Classified")) %>%
  count(origin, experiment, compound_num, status) %>%
  mutate(x_label = interaction(compound_num, origin, sep = " · "),
         x_label = factor(x_label, levels = levels(class_counts$x_label)))

# compounds behind the top 2 taxonomy classes per node/experiment
top_class_per_label_experiment <- class_counts %>%
  group_by(x_label, experiment, taxonomy_class) %>%
  summarise(total_n = sum(n), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(x_label, experiment) %>%
  mutate(proportion = total_n / sum(total_n)) %>%
  slice_max(proportion, n = 2, with_ties = TRUE) %>%
  ungroup()
top_class_per_label_experiment

summary_top_classes <- df_base %>%
  filter(taxonomy_class %in% top_class_per_label_experiment$taxonomy_class) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(compound_num, " . ", origin)) %>%
  select(-origin, -compound_num)

summary_top_classes <- summary_top_classes %>%
  left_join(kegg_name_lookup(summary_top_classes$kegg_id, kegg_names), by = "kegg_id") %>%
  mutate(name_clean = paste0(kegg_id, ": ", name)) %>%
  group_by(experiment, kegg_id) %>%
  mutate(n_labels    = n_distinct(label),
         multi_label = n_labels > 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(experiment = label_zim_experiment(experiment))

contributing_compounds <- ggplot(summary_top_classes, aes(x = label, y = name_clean)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = multi_label), size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "red", `FALSE` = "green"),
                     labels = c(`TRUE` = "Shared", `FALSE` = "Distinct")) +
  facet_grid(taxonomy_class ~ experiment, scales = "free") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.title = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL,
       title = "Compounds contributing to top 3 chemical taxonomy classes\nby node and origin")

save_plot(filename = "figures/ZIM/figure_z_contributing_compounds.png", contributing_compounds,
          base_height = 20, base_width = 13, bg = "white")

# stacked taxonomy-class proportions per node position and origin
p_main <- class_counts %>%
  mutate(experiment = label_zim_experiment(experiment)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = x_label, y = n, fill = taxonomy_class)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill") +
  geom_text(aes(label = as.integer(taxonomy_class)), position = position_fill(vjust = 0.5),
            size = 3, color = "grey4", fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal, labels = class_labels_wrapped) +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~ experiment, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(5.5, 5.5, 5.5, 5.5)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Proportion", fill = "Taxonomy Class",
       title = "Proportion of compounds with classified chemical taxonomy per node position and origin")

p_main_legend <- p_main +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.title = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0.5)) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 3))

p_counts <- ggplot(totals_df, aes(x = x_label, y = n, fill = status)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Classified = "grey90", Unclassified = "grey50")) +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~ experiment, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "right", axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_blank(), plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(5.5, 5.5, 5.5, 5.5)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Number of compounds", fill = NULL,
       title = "Total compounds\n(classified vs. unclassified)")

# Jaccard similarity of classified compound sets
group_sets <- df_base %>%
  filter(!is.na(taxonomy_class)) %>%
  mutate(experiment = label_zim_experiment(experiment),
         group_id   = paste0(compound_num, " · ", origin, " · ", experiment)) %>%
  group_by(group_id) %>%
  summarise(compounds = list(unique(kegg_id)), .groups = "drop")

sets_list   <- setNames(group_sets$compounds, group_sets$group_id)
group_order <- group_sets$group_id

sim_matrix <- expand_grid(group1 = group_order, group2 = group_order) %>%
  mutate(similarity = map2_dbl(group1, group2, ~ jaccard(sets_list[[.x]], sets_list[[.y]])),
         similarity = ifelse(group1 == group2, NA_real_, similarity),
         group1 = factor(group1, levels = group_order),
         group2 = factor(group2, levels = rev(group_order)))

p_heatmap <- ggplot(sim_matrix, aes(x = group1, y = group2, fill = similarity)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(is.na(similarity), "", sprintf("%.2f", similarity))), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#1b9e77", na.value = "grey90",
                      limits = c(0, 1), name = "Jaccard\nsimilarity") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = label_wrap(width = 20)) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = label_wrap(width = 25)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL,
       title = "Similarity of classified compound sets by node position, origin, and experiment")
```

## Immune recovery

```{r immune recovery}
longitudinal_metadata <- read_delim("data/ZIM/zim2_longitudinal.txt", delim = "\t",
                                    escape_double = FALSE, trim_ws = TRUE)

immune_markers <- c(
  "CD4_Percent",
  "CD4_HLADRpos_CD38pos_Percent",
  "CD8_HLADRpos_CD38pos_Percent",
  "CD4_PD1_Percent",
  "CD8_PD1_Percent",
  "IL6_pg_mL",
  "CRP_mg_L"
)

marker_labels <- c(
  CD4_Percent                  = "CD4+(%)",
  CD4_HLADRpos_CD38pos_Percent = "CD4+HLADR+CD38+(%)",
  CD8_HLADRpos_CD38pos_Percent = "CD8+HLADR+CD38+(%)",
  CD4_PD1_Percent              = "CD4+PD1+(%)",
  CD8_PD1_Percent              = "CD8+PD1+(%)",
  IL6_pg_mL                    = "IL-6 (pg/mL)",
  CRP_mg_L                     = "CRP (mg/L)"
)

# baseline diet score
total_score <- longitudinal_metadata %>%
  filter(Visit == 2, PID %in% sampleids) %>%
  select(PID, Total_Score)

# summed abundance of the SIMPER reactions per participant
sum_sig_rxns <- results %>%
  filter(reaction %in% sig_reactions_all) %>%
  group_by(PID) %>%
  summarise(sum_abundance = sum(abundance))

# marker change: visit 3 - visit 2
delta_df <- longitudinal_metadata %>%
  filter(PID %in% sampleids) %>%
  select(PID, Visit, all_of(immune_markers)) %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(immune_markers), names_to = "immune_marker", values_to = "value") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Visit, values_from = value, names_prefix = "V") %>%
  mutate(delta = V3 - V2) %>%
  select(PID, immune_marker, delta) %>%
  mutate(delta_label = case_when(delta < 0  ~ "negative",
                                 delta > 0  ~ "positive",
                                 delta == 0 ~ "no change"),
         im_label = recode(immune_marker, !!!marker_labels))

# distinct reactions per participant (FFQ experiment)
sum_rxns <- results %>%
  filter(experiment == "DietMicrobe_FFQ") %>%
  group_by(PID, gender, cohort, diet) %>%
  summarise(n_rxns = n_distinct(reaction), .groups = "drop")

im_analysis_df <- sum_rxns %>%
  left_join(total_score, by = "PID") %>%
  left_join(delta_df, by = "PID") %>%
  left_join(sum_sig_rxns, by = "PID") %>%
  na.omit()

naive_im_analysis <- im_analysis_df %>% filter(cohort == "Naïve")

# naïve cohort: marker change
fit_lm_by_marker(naive_im_analysis, delta ~ n_rxns + Total_Score, "immune_marker", immune_markers)
fit_lm_by_marker(naive_im_analysis, delta ~ n_rxns, "immune_marker", immune_markers)

ggplot(naive_im_analysis, aes(x = Total_Score, y = n_rxns)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  stat_cor(method = "pearson")

# all cohorts: baseline marker level
baseline_im_analysis <- longitudinal_metadata %>%
  filter(Visit == 2, PID %in% sampleids) %>%
  select(PID, Total_Score, all_of(immune_markers)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(immune_markers), names_to = "marker", values_to = "value") %>%
  left_join(sum_sig_rxns, by = "PID") %>%
  left_join(sum_rxns, by = "PID")

fit_lm_by_marker(baseline_im_analysis, value ~ n_rxns + cohort + Total_Score, "marker", immune_markers)

# mediation: Total_Score -> n_rxns -> marker change
mediation_results <- map_dfr(immune_markers, function(i) {
  data_sub <- naive_im_analysis %>% filter(immune_marker == i)

  # mediate() refits via update(), which looks these up in the global env
  assign("mM_f", n_rxns ~ Total_Score, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  assign("mY_f", delta ~ Total_Score + n_rxns, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  assign("data_sub", data_sub, envir = .GlobalEnv)

  mM <- lm(mM_f, data = data_sub)
  mY <- lm(mY_f, data = data_sub)

  res <- mediation::mediate(mM, mY, treat = "Total_Score", mediator = "n_rxns",
                            boot = TRUE, sims = 500)

  if (res$d0.p <= 0.05) {
    message("Significant mediation for marker: ", i)
    print(summary(res))
  }

  tibble(immune_marker   = i,
         predictor       = "Total_Score",
         mediator        = "n_rxns",
         response        = "delta",
         acme            = res$d0,
         acme_p          = res$d0.p,
         ade             = res$z0,
         ade_p           = res$z0.p,
         total_effect    = res$tau.coef,
         total_p         = res$tau.p,
         prop_mediated   = res$n0,
         prop_mediated_p = res$n0.p)
})

rm(mM_f, mY_f, data_sub, envir = .GlobalEnv)
mediation_results
```
